Acquisition scope: the exact public API FBX 2K selections and their four included texture dependencies only. No archives, executables, source project or add-on. Assets remain unmodified staging files. All downloaded asset sizes and provider MD5 checksums matched; SHA-256 values are recorded per file in manifest.json.

Art caveat: these are terrestrial industrial electrical props, not NASA hardware or flight-certified spacecraft designs. Unity material adaptation, scale, normals, collider choice and any reuse of visible source labels require review before final scene integration.
